message.content: {"note_claim": "The planes in the video are US-operated Globemaster aircraft, not Chinese, and China has not conducted airdrops to Gaza.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Investigations into the footage reveal that most of the clips circulating online actually show a United States aid airdrop over Beit Lahiya, northern Gaza, from March 2024.", "reason": "The page states the footage shows a US C-17 Globemaster III airdrop, that China doesn't operate the C-17, and that there is no credible evidence of Chinese airdrops to Gaza; the note's 'C-26' appears to be a typo for C-17, but the core claim is substantiated."}

parsed.note_claim: The planes in the video are US-operated Globemaster aircraft, not Chinese, and China has not conducted airdrops to Gaza.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Investigations into the footage reveal that most of the clips circulating online actually show a United States aid airdrop over Beit Lahiya, northern Gaza, from March 2024.
parsed.reason: The page states the footage shows a US C-17 Globemaster III airdrop, that China doesn't operate the C-17, and that there is no credible evidence of Chinese airdrops to Gaza; the note's 'C-26' appears to be a typo for C-17, but the core claim is substantiated.
